name: Ovex Durastretch Work Legging
description: Thick, compression-style work leggings designed for physical labor — heavy enough to resist abrasion against equipment and machinery, with reinforced panels over the shins and outer thighs. Worn alone in warm environments or as a base layer under trousers. Common in black or dark grey. Popular with workers who have lower-limb geneware or digitigrade leg modifications because the stretch accommodates non-standard anatomy.
functionality: Abrasion-resistant reinforced panels, compression support, high-stretch fit for modified anatomy
what_it_says: You work hard, you move a lot, and standard trousers don't fit your body or your job.
story_hooks: Ovex leggings are one of the few affordable options for digitigrade-modded workers — a shortage in a district would hit a very specific population hard.
The compression fit leaves little room for concealment, which is exactly why certain employers require them as part of a uniform.
